text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mobilisation against "terrorism"; UGTA trades union federation calls for mass march to commemorate War Veterans' Day on August 20 and "show to the executioners and their masterminds...the determination of Algerians to keep Algeria upright".

- Security forces besiege "terrorists" in bomb factory near Sidi Moussa in Blida province, south of Algiers. "Assault is made difficult because of the fact the armed group has mined all access points to this major laboratory in which are made most of the bombs which spread death in the Algiers area."
- UGTA workers' union calls for national demonstration against "terrorism", and for Algerians to "break the silence".

- From old arguments (seen in parliament) it is possible that the government coalition formed by Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia will show increasing cracks "since there is no lack of points of disagreement".
